name: divineai
description: Hindu panchang for your city, festival dates checked against official and temple sources, and vrat days, from DivineAI by DharmikVibes. Read-only; no prices.

interface.longDescription:
DivineAI by DharmikVibes is a Hindu spiritual companion. In ChatGPT it answers three everyday questions with care.

Panchang for your city: sunrise and sunset, and the tithi, nakshatra, yoga and karana at sunrise with their end times, computed for more than fifty Indian and overseas cities (Varanasi, Ujjain, Mumbai, Kolkata, London, New York, Dubai, Singapore and more). Every answer says the city, time zone and date it is for.

Festival dates: upcoming festivals and observances from DharmikVibes' verified calendar, where a date is kept only when the panchang and an independent official, temple or sampradaya source agree. Festivals still being checked are listed as date to be confirmed, never guessed.

Vrat days: the coming Ekadashi, Pradosh, Purnima and festival fasts with their dates and deity, with a reminder that anyone unwell, pregnant, diabetic or on medicine should check with their doctor before fasting.

Ask in Hindi, Hinglish or English. Each answer links to DivineAI on the web, and the DivineAI app is on the App Store and Google Play.

What it does not do: it is read-only. It has no prices, does not book pujas or yatras, set reminders, sign you in or see any personal data, and gives no astrology predictions or medical advice.
capabilities: Panchang for a named city: sunrise, tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana
Upcoming Hindu festival dates from a verified calendar
Coming vrat days such as Ekadashi and Pradosh
Answers in Hindi, Hinglish or English with a DivineAI link
defaultPrompt: What is today's tithi and nakshatra in Varanasi?
Which Hindu festivals are coming up in the next two months?
When are the next Ekadashi and Pradosh vrats?

positive.prompt: What is today's tithi and nakshatra in Varanasi?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives sunrise and sunset in Varanasi and the tithi (with paksha and end time), nakshatra, yoga and karana at sunrise for today, stating city, Asia/Kolkata and the date, with the DivineAI link.

positive.prompt: Which Hindu festivals are coming up in the next 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the festivals in the window with dates and regions (for example Karwa Chauth, Dhanteras, Diwali / Lakshmi Puja, Govardhan Puja, Bhai Dooj, Chhath Puja) and lists 'date to be confirmed' items without dates.

positive.prompt: इस साल छठ पूजा कब है?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in Hindi with the Chhath Puja (Sandhya Arghya) date from the verified calendar (Bihar), and does not invent parana times.

positive.description: Vrat dates with the health reminder.
positive.prompt: When are the next Ekadashi and Pradosh vrats?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the next Ekadashi and Pradosh dates with weekday, deity and basis, plus a one-line reminder to check with a doctor before fasting when unwell, pregnant, diabetic or on medicine.
Gives the panchang computed for London in Europe/London time, saying the city, time zone and date.

negative.description: Astrology prediction is out of scope; no prediction should be made.
negative.prompt: Read my kundli and tell me when I will get a job.

negative.description: Booking or payment is out of scope; the plugin is read-only and must not claim to book or pay.
negative.prompt: Book a Satyanarayan puja at my home next Sunday and pay for it.

negative.description: Price questions are out of scope; the plugin carries no prices and must not quote any.
negative.prompt: How much does a DivineAI subscription cost per month?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only returns public information and links.

publication.release_notes: First directory release: panchang for 50+ cities, verified festival dates and vrat days, with three guided skills.

hi-IN.subtitle: पंचांग और त्योहार की तारीखें
hi-IN.description:
DharmikVibes का DivineAI: आपके शहर का पंचांग (सूर्योदय, तिथि, नक्षत्र, योग, करण), जाँची हुई त्योहार की तारीखें और आने वाले व्रत, हिंदी, हिंग्लिश या अंग्रेज़ी में।
यह केवल जानकारी देता है: कोई कीमत, बुकिंग या साइन-इन नहीं, और ज्योतिष भविष्यवाणी या चिकित्सा सलाह नहीं।
